summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called HDM1005 in adults with Type 2 Diabetes (a condition where the body cannot properly control blood sugar levels) whose blood sugar is not well managed by diet, exercise, or metformin. The study is currently Recruiting and aims to enroll 216 participants. Hangzhou Zhongmei Huadong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is the sponsor for this Phase 2 study. Participants will receive either HDM1005, a placebo (an inactive substance that looks like the drug), or another active comparison drug.

facts.sponsor: Hangzhou Zhongmei Huadong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
